_rationale: Year 0 cash interest = 4% x $250,000 = $10,000, the sole ordinary income. Federal ordinary tax = $0 ($10k < $16,100 single 2026 standard deduction). Illinois flat 4.95% with no state standard deduction taxes the full $10k -> state ordinary tax = $495.00. ordinaryTax (federal + state ordinary + locality) = $495; totalTax = $495 (no LTCG/NIIT/IRMAA). This asserts cash interest reaches the STATE ordinary base: before the fix the state path used the pre-interest gross ($0), so ordinaryTax/totalTax would read $0 here. Solvent all 4 years -> 100%.
